title: Equipment manufacturers
description: Make transformers, switchgear, turbines, inverters and other equipment. Utilities and generation companies buy it to build and maintain their assets.

title: Regulators
description: FERC regulates most interstate transmission and wholesale electricity sales. State commissions typically oversee investor-owned utility distribution rates and retail supplier rules.

title: ISOs / RTOs
description: Balance regional supply and demand, coordinate transmission, dispatch generators and run wholesale markets. These nonprofits do not own transmission lines.

title: Generation companies
description: Own generating assets and sell power through wholesale markets or contracts. They may operate plants themselves or hire operators.

title: Transmission utilities
description: Own, maintain and physically operate high-voltage lines and substations. Transmission tariffs recover approved costs, including an allowed return for investor-owned utilities.

title: Distribution utilities
description: Own and operate local wires, substations, transformers and meters. Regulated delivery charges fund service, maintenance and approved investment.

title: Retail electricity suppliers
description: Arrange electricity supply through wholesale purchases, contracts or generation, and charge customers for it. The local utility still delivers the power.

title: Generation facilities
description: Facilities that convert energy from fuel, wind, water or sunlight into electricity. Some connect directly to distribution.

title: Transmission network
description: High-voltage lines and substations move bulk power between generators, regions and distribution systems.

title: Distribution network
description: Local lines, substations, transformers and meters deliver electricity to most homes and businesses.

title: Consumers
description: Use electricity and fund supply, networks and grid services through their bills. Some large customers connect directly to transmission.

title: Wholesale markets & settlements
description: A schematic hub for wholesale trades and transmission billing. ISO/RTO trades settle here; bilateral contracts may be paid separately.
